say:1:1062203001:1.text: Ah, there you are, my precious moonstone!
say:1:1062203001:1.source_cn: 噢！我的月光石，我终于找到你了！

say:2:1062203002:1.text: With this, I'm confident I'll receive that divine guidance and make it into the Mithril Consortium.
say:2:1062203002:1.source_cn: 有了你，我一定能得到神启，成功加入秘银商会！

say:3:1062203003:1.text: Thanks a million, Magister! I'm off to seek the gods' wisdom. Wish me luck!
say:3:1062203003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，魔法师大人！我要去聆听神明的启示了，祝我好运吧！
say:3:1062203003:1.male: Thanks a million, Magister! I'm off to seek the gods' wisdom. Wish me luck!
say:3:1062203003:1.female: Thanks a million, Magister! I'm off to seek the gods' wisdom. Wish me luck!
